description.text:
The Sun & Moon Trainer Kit: Alolan Sandslash & Alolan Ninetales, released on 1 June 2018, was the second kit of the Sun & Moon Series and the first whose cards keep their own number, rarity mark and set symbol instead of new kit ones. Each 30-card half deck instead marks every card with a numbered circle at the bottom right, purple for Alolan Sandslash and blue for Alolan Ninetales, giving the order for the example battle in the player's guides. The kit also held a deck box, a playmat, counters, a rule book and a Rotom Dex coin.

This set holds the reprints from the Alolan Ninetales half deck, which runs on Grass and Fairy Energy and draws its cards from Sun & Moon, Guardians Rising, Burning Shadows, Crimson Invasion and Ultra Prism. Its featured Alolan Ninetales, non-holo and holo, is the Sun & Moon Black Star Promo SM128.
